notes: Initial reviewed feature inventory, not an exhaustive normative checklist.
A verified implementation task does not establish UE profile compliance.
Optional features must satisfy their applicable requirements when enabled.

requirements.summary: 确定性纳秒事件、取消与对象销毁
现有 SES/PDS/IPDC/TPDC 在虚拟时间下运行
64 端点运行与确定性输出
Ethernet/IPv4/IPv6/原生 UET/UDP 封装
requirements.evidence_note: IPv4/IPv6/native/UDP and configurable native protocol tested; extension headers remain unsupported. Implemented SES formats ignore reserved receive bits after integrity validation; unimplemented formats remain outside this coverage.

requirements.summary: CRC32C、网络序、UDP checksum 掩码、错误拒绝
requirements.evidence_note: Network byte order, corruption, UDP checksum masking and the explicit trimmed-packet CRC exception tested; TSS/UFH cases remain open.

requirements.summary: 标准请求与语义响应编码
选择 ACK、累计 ACK、重复 ACK 与 PSN 回绕
requirements.evidence_note: Selective/cumulative ACK cleanup and wrap plus peer MPR decoding, stale/future CACK rejection, independent local receive capacity and data/retry admission tested. Complete SACK/default-response/control acceptance remains open; see PDS-WINDOWS.md.

requirements.summary: ROD 建连、数据和语义响应
requirements.evidence_note: Missing-middle go-back-N, EV/CE/RETX feedback, fixed control entropy, Probe SACK and close-loss tested; asynchronous response ordering and complete control/error combinations remain under review.

requirements.summary: 数据/ACK 丢失恢复与有限重试
requirements.evidence_note: Nanosecond RTO, separate NACK/timeout backoff, delayed retry deduplication/cancellation, reserved-code filtering, CMS event/accounting separation and MAC timers tested. Retry-limit configuration/infinite mode, New_Start_PSN and full READ/TSS/control matrices remain open; see RETRY-TIMING.md and NACK-RECOVERY.md.

requirements.summary: RUD 乱序窗口、重复消除及 SACK
requirements.evidence_note: Per-packet SACK, strict CACK default inference, response queries, guaranteed-error recovery, Probe bitmap/window recovery and wrap tested; optional coalescing and full lifecycle/error combinations remain open.

requirements.summary: 无连接 UUD 单包发送与本地完成
requirements.evidence_note: Single-packet local completion, loss without retry, missing receive and no PDC allocation tested.

requirements.summary: 完整 Clear/Close、资源复用与迟到报文
requirements.evidence_note: Normal/lossy initiator close, target Close Request with plain ACK, same-PSN retries, idempotent requests, silent-initiator retry exhaustion, required Close Command CP_ACK and context reuse are tested for ROD/RUD. Full control/negotiation/expected-start and wrap matrix remain open.

requirements.summary: trimming 检测及 NACK 恢复
requirements.evidence_note: Plain IPv4/IPv6/native/UDP switch trimming, unchanged UDP fields, bounds-only restricted parsing, no PDC creation/SES placement from a trimmed header, normal/last-hop NACK and RUD/ROD recovery tested. Additional loss/resource combinations and TSS/other modes remain open.

requirements.summary: JobID 和 MR/PID 作用域授权
内存键、访问权限、边界与撤销
多包 WRITE 的真实内存效果及语义完成
requirements.evidence_note: Native streamed WRITE of 4294967295 bytes completes through 524288 original PDS/fabric fragments with verified markers, cleared bytes and retirement; producer queue <=8, ordered receive intervals <=1, sparse pages <=3. Default CTest covers 8 MiB and loss. Full Profile and other operation size guarantees remain open.

requirements.summary: 预投递缓冲区 SEND 与 NO_OP
WRITE IMM 及 SEND/DGRAM 的远端完成数据
requirements.evidence_note: WRITE data creates a standalone RMA completion; SEND/DGRAM data retains the matching receive context and consumes one posting. Zero/max data, late posting and IE tested; complete profile/address/error combinations remain open.

requirements.summary: 线上的非取回原子操作
requirements.evidence_note: Signed/unsigned integer widths 8/16/32/64, non-fetching arithmetic/logical/bitwise/write; FP, fetch/CAS and semantic-control coverage remain open.

requirements.summary: Profile 规定的消息大小及流式接口
真实 libfabric 2.0 provider
requirements.evidence_note: Experimental libfabric 2.0 maps FI_MSG, SEND/DGRAM CQ data, WRITE/WRITE IMM, integer atomics and recovery through the common kernel; standard UET addresses/auth and remaining flags/profile acceptance remain open. Public API tests now verify independent SEND/RW mode selection, mixed-mode FIFO, any-JobID MR registration and both explicit ROD and RUD late-receive recovery. Standard UET addressing and full authorization configuration remain incomplete. Injection API/flags use bounded owned copies and preserve success/error CQ rules through semantic retries; RDM completion thresholds use the explicitly stronger globally-observable point; DGRAM thresholds use local transmit acceptance. Basic nonblocking EQ FIFO/binding is tested; standard UET addressing, full authorization and asynchronous control production remain incomplete.

requirements.summary: NSCC 准入、窗口与反馈闭环
requirements.evidence_note: Original PDS admission/retries, signed ACK byte clock, NSCC law, plaintext trimming, Probe feedback and MAC timestamps implemented. Deterministic incast, multiple flows, CE/trim, asymmetric ECMP and temporary-outage scenarios now export actual per-hop bytes and completion metrics. Full normative/control/fault acceptance remains open; see NSCC.md and NETWORK-EXPERIMENTS.md.

requirements.summary: 串行化、队列、丢包、链路故障及 ECMP 行为
requirements.evidence_note: Independent TC queues, byte-deficit round robin, dequeue ECN, true trimming, first-bit timing, serialized random loss and link generations tested. YAML config, per-hop PCAP/index and incast/competition/asymmetric/outage examples implemented. Full M4/Profile acceptance remains open; see NETWORK-EXPERIMENTS.md.

精确/通配 tag 与队列匹配
deferrable send 与 restart
rendezvous 与 unexpected 消息
取回原子操作、CAS、数据类型与异常
Sync Group 状态与完成动作
RUDI 无连接、逐包响应与幂等限制
RCCC 接收端信用算法
TFC 信用与重传规则
CSIG 编码、交换机信号与反馈
安全域、KDF、AES-GCM、计数器与轮换
安全建连、重放与 epoch 拒绝
LLR 协议与链路重试行为
CBFC/PFC 信用、停顿及恢复
LLDP 能力协商与不匹配处理
速率/延迟、误码、FEC 延迟与统计抽象
能力、安全域、JobID 与设备统计管理
RODL 双向 PDC、累计确认与错误模型
局部事务头、打包及直接寻址
UFH_16/32、CRC 与 TSS 路径
官方实现的进程级标准报文互通
requirements.evidence_note: Independent processes use unchanged pinned reference SES/PDS and a test-only UDP-frame NIC adapter: WRITE/SEND, uint64 SUM and return SEND, completions and Clear retirement pass. Raw-NIC/veth tests and additional operation/encapsulation/fault combinations remain open.

requirements.summary: 相对/绝对 PID、独立资源索引、generation 与任意 JobID MR 授权
requirements.evidence_note: Native address selection and scope checks pass; optimized/local formats and all key classes remain open.

requirements.summary: 消息完成、PSN 关联和协议驱动的消息 ID 退休
requirements.evidence_note: 66000 exactly-once integer operations cross the 16-bit message-ID space; EOM-scoped default responses, explicit full-length RUD completion and error-path ID leases are checked independently.

requirements.summary: 整条消息保留首错；IE/MSG_ERROR 不访问内存，终止尾部并保留错误完成数据
requirements.evidence_note: Late fragments cannot consume new postings; bounded failure-state exhaustion, IE, MSG_ERROR before SOM in RUD, error CQ header data, local reader exceptions, no reads after error and zero-placement SEND truncation tested. Informational error precedence, complete recovery/generation handling and other header formats remain open.

requirements.summary: NOOP/NO_NEG 控制包建连、独立 PSN、ACK Request 处理状态
requirements.evidence_note: ROD/RUD control-only opening followed by checked WRITE, SYN/ACK loss and safety delay, 32-byte NO_NEG, unsupported on-off negotiation plain ACK, invalid SYN CP rejection and ACK-request processing/cache/missing/below-Clear/wrap states are exercised. Negotiated features, Probe/Credit/PCM and extended ACK variants remain open.

requirements.summary: 有界 ROD unexpected 缓冲、资源代次恢复及最早消息的受限软件重试
requirements.evidence_note: Late/partial receive posting, ordered placement, zero-placement truncation, disabled-generation responses and re-enable, stale generation, SEND/RMA isolation, RUD no-match/manual retry, transport-retirement query and partial receive error on PDC failure are checked. Public API processes cover delayed receive, hidden intermediate errors, bounded retry failure and subsequent RMA. Full MR key classes, ordered/API acceptance and cross-peer recovery matrices remain open.

requirements.summary: 完整 48 位 RKEY、64 位元数据、含零值的命名空间与独立撤销身份
requirements.evidence_note: Native non-optimized application keys cover full 48-bit range, zero Job/PID/key/index and distinct relative Job/PID/index scopes. Absolute selection ignores Job for lookup and rejects ambiguous equal RKEYs, including differing idempotent metadata. SEND/UUD postings pin live registration identity, preventing cross-Job reselection and stale-key rebinding. Duplicate binding, permission fallback and stale/foreign revocation are rejected. Provider declares six RKEY bytes and preserves 64-bit idempotent metadata with optimized fallback. Optimized headers and provider application-assigned key mode remain open.

requirements.summary: 接收端将非匹配 DEFERRABLE_SEND 作为 SEND 处理
requirements.evidence_note: Narrow receiver compatibility behavior only: opcode 0x08, token/address separation, posting/NoMatch in both ROD and RUD, explicit retry and header data. Full deferral/RTR/restart and tagged deferrable sends remain unimplemented.
